visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with dark hair and bangs appears in a close-up shot indoors, touching her hair near the roots. She wears a white top and a brown bag strap is visible. The background shows a window with soft natural light and a woven chair. (2) The scene cuts to an outdoor urban area during the day where a dense crowd of people is queuing in front of a modern building with Expo 2025 branding. Several people are holding umbrellas for shade. (3) The woman is shown outdoors again, this time with a man standing slightly behind her. She has a white cloth or towel draped over the top of her head, presumably to protect her hair from the sun's heat. (4) Transitioning back to an indoor setting, the woman holds two purple translucent bottles of L'Oreal Paris shampoo and conditioner. She stands in front of a bookshelf filled with books and decorative objects under bright studio-style lighting. (5) Close-up views show the clear liquid of the shampoo being pumped onto a palm, followed by another shot showing thick white foam being massaged between hands to demonstrate the product's texture. (6) A split-screen visual comparison is presented, showing the woman's dark hair from a back view. The left side is labeled 'Before' showing flatter hair, and the right side is 'After' showing noticeably more voluminous and shiny hair. (7) A montage shows her in various settings: wearing a beige cap outdoors, sitting in a car with a plush Batman toy, and standing in front of cinema posters. She later appears in a bathroom holding an iPad that displays the time as 10:14 PM. (8) In the final phase, she is in a bathroom with beige tiles, using a large pink hairbrush to style her hair. She gives a thumbs-up to the camera while holding the purple product bottles, appearing satisfied with the results.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with an upbeat, high-tempo electronic pop track featuring a strong, driving percussive beat. A young female voice speaks with high energy and an enthusiastic tone, narrating her experience. (2) A transition occurs marked by a subtle whoosh sound effect as she describes the heat during her trip. The background music remains steady, providing a positive and energetic floor for her clear, fast-paced speech. (3) As the narration shifts to the product review, the music maintains its bright tone. A 'ding' sound effect highlights the appearance of text on screen, while the speaker's pitch varies to emphasize key benefits of the shampoo. (4) The final phase features the same consistent musical bed as the speaker delivers a enthusiastic recommendation. The audio concludes with a clear, studio-quality vocal finish and a slight fade in the background music.
